Holds copies of buys to the workflow's limits: caps a copy, a market and a day, a price band and categories. Copies over a cap are made smaller; sells always go ahead.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `trading.riskGuard` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main`, `blocked` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Max $ a copy (`maxPerCopy`) | number | no |  | The most one copy spends. |
| Max $ a market (`maxPerMarket`) | number | no |  | The most the workflow holds in one market, at cost, all traders' copies together. |
| Max $ a day (`maxPerDay`) | number | no |  | The most the workflow's buys spend in 24 hours. |
| Least price (`minPrice`) | number | no |  | Buys at a lower price are blocked. |
| Most price (`maxPrice`) | number | no |  | Buys at a higher price are blocked. |
| Only categories (`categories`) | list of text | no |  | Buys only in markets with one of these tags, like Politics; empty: any. |
| Not categories (`notCategories`) | list of text | no |  | No buys in markets with any of these tags, like Sports. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on with these fields added. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `guard` | object; not always there | When a cap made the copy smaller: by how much, and which. |
| `guard.from` | decimal | The copy's dollars before. |
| `guard.reason` | text | Which cap, and what it left. |
| `blocked` | object; not always there | Out of blocked: why the copy may not go ahead. |
| `blocked.reason` | text | Which limit, and how it was reached. |
